description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to deterministic or theme-based colors, primarily used for visualizing statuses in a dark-themed dashboard.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color, with fallbacks to deterministic color generation for unknown statuses.
